sentences.en: In the coffee house people sat in the evening.

sentences.ar: הם דיברו על השמש ועל הירח.
sentences.en: They talked about the sun and about the moon.
One asked: which is more important?
Everyone answered: the sun, of course.
Juha sat in the corner and drank.
He said: you are completely wrong.
Everyone turned and looked at him.

sentences.ar: הם שאלו: אז מה יותר חשוב?
sentences.en: They asked: so which is more important?
Juha said: the moon, without doubt.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: תחשבו על זה רגע.
sentences.en: He said: think about it a moment.
He said: the moon comes at night.
He said: at night it is very dark.
He said: and we need light.
He said: the sun comes in the day.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: וביום ממילא יש אור.
sentences.en: He said: and in the day there is light anyway.
Everyone was silent and thought about it.
